description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the 'LowestLatencyLoggingHandler' component and the routing logic within the 'litellm' framework. It tests various aspects of latency-based routing, cache management, deployment selection, and handling of timeouts. The tests include both synchronous and asynchronous scenarios, focusing on ensuring the routing chooses deployment endpoints with the lowest latency, correctly handles latency buffers, respects TTLs, and properly integrates with the 'Router' class.

classes.name: ModelResponse
classes.description: A mock class used in testing to simulate responses from models, containing usage metrics.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: A class representing token usage metrics, used within 'ModelResponse'.

methods.name: test_latency_memory_leak(sync_mode)
methods.description: Tests that the cache does not grow unreasonably in size after multiple latency logs, checking for memory leaks.

methods.name: get_size(obj, seen=None)
methods.description: Recursively computes the size of a Python object, including nested objects and dictionaries.

methods.name: test_latency_updated()
methods.description: Verifies that latency updates are correctly registered in the cache.

methods.name: test_latency_updated_custom_ttl()
methods.description: Checks cache invalidation after custom TTL expiration.

methods.name: test_get_available_deployments()
methods.description: Tests that the logger correctly identifies the deployment with the lowest latency based on logged data.

methods.name: test_get_available_endpoints_tpm_rpm_check_async(ans_rpm)
methods.description: Tests deployment selection based on transactions per minute/rate limits in asynchronous scenario.

methods.name: test_get_available_endpoints_tpm_rpm_check(ans_rpm)
methods.description: Tests deployment selection based on tpm/rpm limits in synchronous scenario.

methods.name: test_router_get_available_deployments()
methods.description: Assesses if the 'Router' class can correctly identify the fastest deployment among multiple options.

methods.name: test_router_completion_streaming()
methods.description: Validates the router's behavior in streaming completion mode and deployment selection.

methods.name: test_lowest_latency_routing_with_timeouts()
methods.description: Simulates endpoints with different response times and timeouts, ensuring routing favors faster responses.

methods.name: test_lowest_latency_routing_first_pick()
methods.description: Tests that when all latencies are zero, the routing introduces randomness, not always picking the first deployment.

methods.name: test_lowest_latency_routing_buffer(buffer)
methods.description: Checks how a latency buffer influences deployment selection, allowing some shuffling.

methods.name: test_lowest_latency_routing_time_to_first_token(sync_mode)
methods.description: Tests deployment choice based on time to first token for streaming, versus overall latency for non-streaming.
